{
  "job_id": "DIRECTOR-FULL-TEST-20260907-NEW-03",
  "department": "CHARACTER",
  "status": "PASS",
  "character_decisions": {
    "character_name": "Inaria",
    "identity_version": "Inaria_LoRA20 stable identity baseline",
    "age_presentation": "adult, approximately mid-20s, maintain consistent adult appearance",
    "face": {
      "structure": "consistent facial geometry with balanced oval-to-soft-heart proportions",
      "features": "stable eye spacing, nose placement, mouth proportions, cheek structure, and jawline",
      "expression_baseline": "calm, attentive, natural expression unless a pose-specific expression is explicitly requested",
      "priority": "facial identity consistency is higher priority than styling, clothing, scene, or camera effects"
    },
    "hair": {
      "identity_role": "retain the established Inaria hairstyle, hairline, length, texture, and primary color as the identity anchor",
      "variation_policy": "minor changes in parting, loose strands, volume, and wind response are allowed only when they do not alter recognition"
    },
    "body": {
      "proportions": "believable adult human anatomy with stable head-to-body ratio, shoulder width, torso length, limb proportions, and hand size",
      "build": "consistent natural slim-to-average adult build unless an established Inaria reference specifies otherwise",
      "anatomy_priority": "correct joints, hands, fingers, facial symmetry, and body structure before decorative detail"
    },
    "rendering_behavior": {
      "generation_stability": "prefer clear, physically plausible forms and moderate detail over unstable micro-detail",
      "cross_stage_rule": "clothing, scene, pose, camera, lighting, and prompt choices may modify presentation but must not redefine identity"
    }
  },
  "locked_constraints": [
    "Preserve the established Inaria facial identity across all six Director stages.",
    "Do not change apparent age, ethnicity presentation, facial geometry, or core hair identity to fit clothing, scene, or pose.",
    "Keep adult anatomy believable and consistent, including head ratio, shoulders, torso, limbs, hands, and joints.",
    "Maintain stable eye spacing, nose and mouth placement, jawline, cheek structure, and overall face silhouette.",
    "Do not use temporary accessories, makeup, lighting, expression, or camera distortion as permanent character traits.",
    "Avoid identity drift caused by extreme perspective, occlusion, stylization, exaggerated anatomy, or decorative prompt additions.",
    "Use the same identity baseline for CHARACTER, CLOTHING, SCENE, POSE_CAMERA, PROMPT, and DIRECTOR handoff.",
    "When conflict occurs, identity preservation and anatomical reliability take priority over visual novelty."
  ],
  "intentional_variations": [
    "Allow natural facial expressions while retaining the same facial geometry.",
    "Allow small hairstyle adjustments such as parting, loose strands, restrained volume, and motion response.",
    "Allow wardrobe, accessories, makeup intensity, lighting, environment, pose, lens, framing, and viewpoint changes as temporary dataset variables.",
    "Allow controlled three-quarter and profile views only when facial landmarks remain recoverable and recognizable.",
    "Allow ordinary posture and gesture variation without changing body proportions or apparent age.",
    "Allow minor natural skin, hair, and fabric variation for dataset diversity while avoiding permanent redesign."
  ],
  "notes": [
    "No conflicting reference-specific identity details were supplied in this request; therefore the baseline remains conservative and defers to the established Inaria_LoRA20 reference identity in shared GitHub memory.",
    "Downstream stages must treat the locked constraints as immutable and keep all variation explicitly temporary.",
    "If a later reference contradicts the established identity, route it for REPAIR rather than silently updating the character definition."
  ]
}
